image_description: A black assault rifle (appearing to be an AR-15/M4 platform variant) lying on a yellow cloth surface. The rifle features a long barrel with a free-floating handguard, a receiver with a carry handle/optic mount, a pistol grip, and a stock. To the right of the rifle, there are disassembled components including a spring, pins, and what appears to be a bolt carrier group or similar internal parts. A blue optical sight is mounted on top. In the background, there is a green fabric item and a cardboard box with text/diagrams.
